visual_action: A close-up, static shot of Vice President Kamala Harris speaking from behind a podium with two microphones. She is looking forward, directly addressing the audience/camera. The background is dark and nondescript.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Visually identified on screen speaking directly to the camera for the entire duration of the clip.

cast.name: the sitting US President

on_screen_text.text: VP Harris' reminder to the American people

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris states that the American people have the power to elect leaders who will defend their rights. She adds that with their vote, they can act and have the "final word," concluding, "So this is not over."
audio_music: The only audio is clear, spoken dialogue from Kamala Harris. No music or other sound effects are present.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static, uncut shot of a talking head.
central_claim: American voters have the ultimate power and final say in protecting their rights by voting for leaders who will defend them.
intended_effect: To empower and motivate viewers to vote by reminding them of their civic power and responsibility.
